name: crowntowncompost-mcp
description: Crown Town Compost pickups, invoices, and service skips for Claude — access via natural language

crowntown_session_cookie.title: Portal Session Cookie
crowntown_session_cookie.description: A Cookie header from an already-signed-in portal session (e.g. "sessionid=…; csrftoken=…"). Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.

crowntown_username.title: Portal Username
crowntown_username.description: Your portal.crowntowncompost.com username or email address. Needed only if you are not supplying a session cookie above.

crowntown_password.title: Portal Password
crowntown_password.description: Your Crown Town Compost customer-portal password. Needed only if you are not supplying a session cookie above.

tools.name: crowntown_update_account

tools.name: crowntown_list_upcoming_services
tools.description: List upcoming collection days that can be skipped

tools.name: crowntown_skip_service
